facts.text: Deborah visited her mother's old house on a bench last Sunday, which she found to be a comforting experience that felt like her mother's presence guided her.

evidence.quote: Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.

facts.text: Deborah's mother had a passion for cooking and made meals full of love and warmth, which brought the family together.

evidence.quote: My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth.

facts.text: Deborah remembers the smell of her mother's special dish, which filled the house and brought everyone together.

evidence.quote: I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.

facts.text: Deborah recalls her mother baking pineapple birthday cakes for her as a child, which made her feel special.

evidence.quote: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special.
